Reference image 1 shows the chosen TEMPEST RIDGE terrain material swatch. No text, letters, numbers, labels, UI or watermark anywhere.  Do not copy the reference's stone-wall layout: a clean grid of exactly five columns and four rows, twenty tiles, with no square outlines drawn around the cells. Every tile is different: only one tile has the snow-capped top, the three fills are bare slate, the ceiling edge has icicles on its underside, and the two slopes face opposite ways; corner and slope tiles are cut-out shapes whose empty part is the flat green key.

- FULL-BLEED OPAQUE painted panel: every pixel of the whole sheet is painted scenery, edge to edge — NO chroma key, NO border, NO frame, NO green anywhere.

Storm-grey granite with a pale frost rim and cold blue shadows — the established TEMPEST RIDGE material. Flat 2D, no perspective, no 3D bevels.
